notes.title: The Fire Spooky Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/3167b09dd35adfcbabf064534e7cc1d1013174e1.png[/img]
[h1]The Spooky Update![/h1]
[h2]Hello![/h2]
Hello everyone! I know it's been a pretty long time but there's finally a new event map for The Fire!  This map is completely free and available now in the extras tab in game!  I really appreciate the support I've received on this game and it means a lot to me to see all the people who've enjoyed it.  Unfortunately, this will likely be the last major update to The Fire, so hopefully you all enjoy it!
[h2]Alpha Level[/h2]
Something I've thought would be interesting and have wanted to add for a while is the alpha map from the original demo of The Fire, so for a new extras level I've ported the very first map for The Fire into a new level, just for people to see the history of the fire.
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2]
-The 'Spooky' chapter
-Some spooky new tunes
-Two new achievements to unlock in the Spooky chapter
-The 'Alpha' chapter
-A new achievement for beating the Alpha chapter
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
-Balanced out multiple platforms in different levels
-Adjusted some of the controller settings for the menu
-Fixed an issue with improper saving

tags.feature: -Two new achievements to unlock in the Spooky chapter
-A new achievement for beating the Alpha chapter

tags.balance_change: -Balanced out multiple platforms in different levels
-Adjusted some of the controller settings for the menu

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/4c1c39951565dda10452159c3f6550db39da2ea5.png[/img]
[h1]Housekeeping[/h1]
Hello everyone, it's been a good while since I've put out an update for this game but it's finally time!  This update is focused on implementing some quality of life features and fixing old bugs.
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Added[/h2]
- New model for vents
- Full controller support
[h2]Changed[/h2]
- Made it easier to get the falling achievement in the winter level
- Adjusted visuals during chapter 3
- Adjusted level layout in the winter level
- Adjusted colors to be more consistent across screens
- UI is more consistent across screens
- Player respawns sooner after falling in chapter 3
- Altered the ending to be more interesting
- Several platforms adjusted to be more fair
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where not all achievements were obtainable
- Fixed the camera moving inconsistently during button cutscenes
- Fixed an issue with the map not generating properly
- The permanent booming sound effect in chapter 2 level 3
[h1]Wrap up[/h1]
Hope this update helps anyone who was wanting to play with controller.  Coming up soon, there's going to be some new content in the game so I hope everyone is excited.

notes.title: The Winter Update & Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/e60d9ff2d9f60455cc315062831611dd84edaa2f.png[/img]
[h1]The Winter Update![/h1]
[h2]Intro[/h2]
Hello everyone! I'm excited to announce that Version 1.04 of The Fire is here, this means that, alongside several bug fixes, there is an entire new chapter to be played!  There has been an extras tab added to the main menu that allows you to access the brand new 'Winter' chapter. It has new mechanics, music, and achievements to go along with it. So I hope you enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/5cdbb3abd33fadab9e7b79b7674aee4bce0c7887.png[/img]
I am Excited to announce that 'The Fire' will be taking part in the Steam Winter Sale.  For a whopping 50% off, you can get the fire for the cheapest it has ever been, so if you've been waiting to get it, now is the time!
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
And to wrap this post up, here are the patch notes for this update:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
-Extras tab on the main menu
-The 'Winter' chapter
-Winter themed music
-Three new achievements to go along with the 'Winter' chapter
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
-Chapter two generation errors
-Post processing errors in the 3rd chapter
[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
Thank you to everyone who has the game, and I hope to see how everyone enjoys the new winter content, I intend to add future seasonal content, so stay tuned.

tags.feature: -Three new achievements to go along with the 'Winter' chapter

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/397d60ee6370d9bb64d177181a9e3b077057758e.png[/img]
[h1]Version 1.1[/h1]
[h2]Intro[/h2]
Thank you to everyone who has gotten the fire since launch day, I know there has been quite a few bugs, but that is why you are reading this today, let's get into it.
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
-Several places you could become stuck
-Glitch out of the map through waterfall
-Totems returning after reloading the game
-Controllers not completely working with the game
-Totem noises would occasionally stay after collection
-The Mac branch was stuck on an older version of the game
-Music wouldn't continue where it left off after reload
[h2]Additions[/h2]
-New totem noises
-A pause menu
-'I'm Stuck' Feature (returns you to center of map)
[h2]Wrap Up[/h2]
The game had a wonderful launch day and was far more successful than I expected it to be, so thank you to everyone who has played it and I hope you enjoyed it!

notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/f238c6979d653fdfcc3f8ce4214ea59618590e12.png[/img]
[h1]The Full Release[/h1]
[h3]Intro[/h3]
Hello everyone, I am happy to say that The Fire is now going to be making a full release, this means transitioning from Early Access and adding a bunch of fun stuff, such as...
[h2]New Content[/h2]
-Achievements
-Saving
-Several more chapters
-All new music
And Lot's of other stuff!
[h2]What Now?[/h2]
Well as for the future of the fire, this will be the last major content update, I do plan on perhaps making seasonal content and themed levels, but the story is done. There will likely be several updates to come of bug fixes so be ready for that, but until then.
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Fixing It Up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38413504/2966be999e29affc7247fa605724807abd07ccc7.png[/img][h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]
Thank you to everyone who has been patiently awaiting new content for 'The Fire'. Rest easy knowing that it is still being actively worked on.  For proof, here is todays update, as minor as it might be.
for starters, past the recent price drop, here is what's been changed.
[h3]Changes[/h3]
-Saving
-Graphical Improvements
-Optimization
-Mac OS support
-Steam OS/Linux support
-Several additional secrets
-Adjustments to level changing
-Adjustments to difficulty
-Fixed [i]several[/i] bugs
And while there has been more things than that, those are really the major items of interest, now for reference, here are some of the things that will, [i]hopefully[/i], be making a full release later this month.
[h3]Upcoming[/h3]
-More chapters
-Steam Achievements
[h3]Wrap-up[/h3]
Expect more content to be released in upcoming weeks, and once again thank you to everyone who has purchased the game and is interested in it.  if you're looking for more information, feel free to check me out on [url=https://twitter.com/daegonstam]twitter[/url] or alternatively, take a look at [url=https://dragonstramp.github.io/pages/thefire.html]The Fire's Website[/url]
